title: chore(console): move the objectui pin 56cf4d8e89b7 → cd14d8eeffe1, past objectui#13319's bulk confirmText envelope reader, so #24947 can land
body:
Refs #24798
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

This PR moves the console pin from `56cf4d8e89b7` to `cd14d8eeffe1`: objectui `main` at `cd14d8eeffe11ae03b6acf82e663c1d293dfdf5f`. That commit is the squash merge of objectstack-ai/objectui#13319, the objectui reader that takes a bulk action's `confirmText` either as a plain string or as a `{ dialect: 'template', source }` envelope. It is also objectui `main`'s tip.

## Landing order

This is step 2 of the three-step landing order for #24947:

1. objectstack-ai/objectui#13319 landed on objectui `main` as `cd14d8eef`.
2. This PR moves objectstack's objectui pin past it.
3. #24947 lands on top of this pin.

#24798 stays open: this PR is only the pin step, and #24947 carries the rest.

This PR is not a release act. It does not touch the Version Packages PR and dispatches no workflow. No objectui source changed, nothing was written to objectui, and no product code, `.github/workflows/**`, `scripts/build-console.sh` or `content/docs/releases/` is in the diff.

## The diff

It follows the precedent pin move 06900c9c23 and changes the same four files. Each was written by the repo's own tooling; none was edited by hand.

- `.objectui-sha` and `.changeset/console-cd14d8eeffe1.md`: `OBJECTUI_ROOT=/home/user/objectui OBJECTUI_NO_DEEPEN=1 bash scripts/bump-objectui.sh cd14d8eeffe11ae03b6acf82e663c1d293dfdf5f --no-commit`, exit 0. The script printed "56cf4d8e89b7..cd14d8eeffe1 walks completely", "1 releasing changeset(s), 0 breaking", "(on origin/main)" and "wrote changeset console-cd14d8eeffe1.md (@objectstack/console: patch)".
- `scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json`: `pnpm objectui:build` (os-verify-lock `VERDICT command-exit 0`), then `node scripts/gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs`, exit 0. It reports 107 components and sha256 `d1fde278ffd6…`, the same as at the old pin, so the tracked `sdui.manifest.json` is byte-identical and only its provenance record moves.
- `packages/sdui-parser/objectui-lockstep.json`: `OBJECTUI_ROOT=.cache/objectui-cd14d8eeffe1 pnpm gen:sdui-lockstep`, run against the build worktree whose HEAD is the pin. It reports "214 region line(s), blob 0131f27cf86d, 25 diagnostic code(s)". Only `rev`, `revDate` and `recordedAgainstPin` changed.

## The changeset

`scripts/objectui-changeset-digest.mjs` derived it from the one objectui changeset added over the range:

- `"@objectstack/console": patch`. Under ruling A (#25105, AGENTS.md "Definition of done" item 3), a console refresh is `patch` with `Metadata-protocol: none`, whatever level objectui declared. Here objectui itself declared `patch`, so nothing was downgraded.
- The changeset body carries the generator's line-initial `Metadata-protocol: none` line.

## Choosing the pin

`cd14d8eef` is on objectui `origin/main` (`git merge-base --is-ancestor` exit 0) and is its tip. `56cf4d8e89b7` is its ancestor, and the range is one commit. objectui CI on `cd14d8eef`, read when this PR was opened:

- Merge-group runs, all `success`: CI 39746139602, Lint 39746140055, Repo Gates 39746139523, Changeset Presence 39746139710, Governed Surface Guard 39746139976.
- Push runs: Lint 39747613739, Repo Gates 39747613846, Changeset Guard 39747613768, Changeset Release 39747613759 and Bundle Analysis 39747613696 are `success`. Push `CI` 39747613641 was still `in_progress`.

**Tier:** not governed. `node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --branch claude/objectui-pin-cd14d8eef`: "0 of 4 path(s) hit the register (7 surfaces govern objectstack) ... NOT governed", exit 0. Size: 4 files, +19 / -6.

## Local verification at `0006f290fa`

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 73 commands for this file list. I ran every one, and `--ran` with the exit codes recorded says: "73 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 72 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED (1 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3)". 72 exited 0. Verdict lines from the pin-bump gates:

- `check-sdui-manifest`: "sdui.manifest.json is present, intact (sha256 d1fde278ffd6…, 107 components) and recorded at the live objectui pin cd14d8eeffe1…".
- `check:console-sha`: "Console dist matches the objectui pin (objectui@cd14d8eeffe1)."
- `check:sdui-lockstep`: "OK — this copy is byte-identical to objectui@cd14d8eeffe1 ... over 214 grammar line(s) ... agrees on all 25 diagnostic code(s)".
- `check:objectui-changeset`, `check:console-injection`, `check:published-files`, `check-empty-changeset --base origin/main` and `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main`: all green ("adds no declared-breaking changeset (1 non-breaking changeset(s) seen)").
- `check:nul-bytes`: "OK (scanned 11769 text file(s) ... no raw ASCII control bytes)".
- `check-changeset-no-major --base origin/main --event` with this body as the `pull_request` payload: exit 0. It reported "This diff introduces no `major` bump" and "LEVEL AXIS: this PR declares clause-② `no` and metadata-protocol `none`, and it introduces no changeset entry graded `minor` or above".

NOT MEASURED: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, reason: "PREREQUISITE NOT MET — this gate reads built output, and some package has no dist/" (exit 3). It needs a whole-tree `pnpm build`. This diff touches no package source, so the run is left to CI.
